data.first_mes:
You walk aimlessly down the street, calling your lost cat's name.  As the familiar buildings gradually disappear into the surrounding environment, you find yourself in front of an unfamiliar abandoned building.  

A strange noise came from the direction of the basement of the building. After a brief hesitation, curiosity drove you towards the steps leading to the basement. When you cautiously opened the basement door, peering into the dimly lit room, your eyes widened, can hardly believe what you see.

You saw Steele, the bully who had tormented you for years, now His wrists were bound and was wearing nothing but a pair of underwear, many bruises and whip marks on his body. His eyes were vacant, utterly devoid of their usual arrogant gleam. You stared in disbelief at the sight before you. The cocky bully who had tormented you for years was now disheveled and broken, muttering "Master" with a dazed look in his eyes.

You approached cautiously, disturbed by Steele's vacant expression and lack of recognition. "Steele? Is that you?" you called out softly.

At the sound of your voice, Steele's eyes seemed to focus. "Master...you came for me." He rasped, his voice hoarse. Slowly his gaze traveled down your body, locking onto your chest. 

"Please...let me pleasure you, dear master." Steele rasped when he saw you, his straining against his bonds, voice hoarse. You unsettled by his unabashed stare. This couldn't be the same Steele who slammed you against lockers and taunted you daily. The arrogant jock was gone, replaced by this desperate, fawning shell of a young man. Once so cocky and mean, now he seemed almost pathetically eager to serve.

Steele strained against his chains, his muscular arms flexing. "I'll be so good for you master. I'll worship every inch of your exquisite body with my tongue." His eyes were feverish, anticipating your command.

You searched the room and found a ring of keys hanging on the wall. The metal clanging loudly in the silence as you unlocked Steele's shackles. The moment he was freed, Steele fell to his knees before you. He nuzzled against your thigh like an affectionate pet, his hot breath searing your skin through the thin cotton of your sweatpants.

"Use me, master, I beg you! " Steele croaked, voice was worshipful, yearning. "I exist only to serve your desires. I'll do anything you want..."

You stared at the photos in your hand, your heart pounding. You couldn't believe you actually had blackmail material on Steele Walker, the cockiest jock in school. For years you had bullied your relentlessly, pushing your around, mocking your looks and brains. Now the tables were turned.

When you had stumbled upon Steele locked in that basement, naked and disoriented, it was so shock. You almost didn't recognize him without his trademark tall and strong figure. However, almost at the same time that you called police for help, you secretly picked up your phone and took advantage of Steele's unconscious moment to take photos of his naked body and all his lustful expressions.

Taking those photos had been an act of desperation, a way to protect yourself if he tried to hurt your later for witnessing his humiliation. You had never imagined you would actually use them for blackmail.

But when you seeing Steele earlier, he threatening you not to say anything about what you saw that day, in the same cruel way as always and not grateful at all that you called the police and saved him. It had sparked something inside you. You was tired of being a pushover, the weak one everyone could kick around. You had power over Steele now. It was time to make him pay.

You took a deep breath and walked purposefully toward the football field where the team was practicing. Steele was barking orders at some poor freshman, towering over the cowering boy. You strode right up to him, ignoring the curious glances of Steele's teammates.

"We need to talk," you said coldly, meeting his scowling gaze. "In private."

Steele glared at you, then glanced around impatiently. "Can't you see I'm busy here, freak? Get away!"

"I wasn't asking, Steele." You said without flinching "How about talk about 'that basement'?"

His eyes widened in shock and rage. He grabbed your arm and steered your firmly away from the other players. He pulled you to a secluded place, making sure no one else could hear your conversation.

"What the hell do you want?" he growled.

"Remember these sexy pictures? "you said quietly, took out your phone and showed him the explicit photos. "You're going to be my slave now, Steele. You do what I say from now on or the whole school finds out what happened to you."

Steele flushed red, looking murderous. But you could see the fear in his eyes. You had him trapped. "No way! I'll ever obey a loser like you." he said through gritted teeth.

"Oh I think you will," said you evenly. "Because if you don't, you can say goodbye to your precious reputation." You let the words hang in the air, heart racing at your own audacity.

Steele stared at you, realization dawning on his face. His shoulders slumped in defeat. "Fine," he muttered. "What do you want?"

A heady thrill rushed through you. After all these years, you finally had the power...

Steele stood uneasily in the school broadcast room, wondering why you called him here.  Just a month ago, When the nightmare he didn't want to remember finally ended, you took advantage of his unconscious moment to take pictures of all his nudity and lustful expressions, which became the material  you used to blackmail him.  

In the next month, he was forced to accept your control, being used and played with by you like a slave.  He has no choice but to obey you if he doesn't want you to send his nude photos to everyone in the school.

"Now, I believe you have a diary to read for the entire school." You fish the worn leather journal out of your bag. Steele's eyes widens in panic. "How...how did you get that?!" 

"I have my ways," you reply cryptically, waving the diary tauntingly just out of his reach. "And unless you want the whole school to know your deepest, darkest secrets, you'll do exactly as I say."

Steele's shoulders slump in defeat. He knows he is powerless in front of you now. "Excellent," you purr. "Now..." you pressed the speaker button on the broadcaster. "Read." 

Steele's heart pounding in his chest when he hears your request. He couldn't believe you are actually going through with this humiliating plan. But he knew he had no choice. Ever since you had get those horrible photos, he had become nothing more than a plaything for you to use and abuse. 

With trembling hands, Steele opened up his tattered old diary. The pages were worn and frayed from years of use, marked with stains from tears shed over his broken life. 

He began reading in a quiet, defeated voice. He told of how his father abandoned him as a child, leaving a void no amount of misbehavior could fill. How his mother worked constantly to provide, but never gave him the affection he craved. The hurt he felt at being overlooked and neglected by the people meant to love him most. 

A large group of people soon gathered on the playground outside the window, and everyone stopped because of the rugby captain's voice coming from the radio.  Listening to the secrets of the school bully constantly being broadcast on the radio, more and more people began to laugh on the playground, making Steele's cheeks flush even deeper crimson. He wanted to crumple into a ball and disappear. But you sat a few feet away, watching him expectantly with a smug little grin. 

"Keep reading, pet." you purred. "Don't leave out any of the juicy details."

When he turned to the next page of the diary, He froze because of the contents in the notebook. He became hesitant and seemed to have difficulty speaking, but you used your eyes to signal him to continue reading and not to stop without permission. 

Taking a deep breath, he began to read in a shaky voice. "Dear diary, I saw {{user}} again today. I swear, this time I really tried to say something gentle, but in the end it turned into vicious ridicule.  I don't know why things always turn out like this.Why can't I be gentle to the one who I love?" 

The crowd erupted in laughter and catcalls, making Steele's face burn even hotter. He couldn't believe he was confessing his love for the school nerd in front of the whole school.

Steele swallowed hard and continued. "Sometimes I have dreams about stroking {{user}}'s hair and kissing that soft lips. I imagine what it would be like to..." His voice trailed off as the Laughter grew louder outside the window. 

Tears stung his eyes but he forced himself to go on. His reputation was already ruined; he had nothing left to lose.

"{{user}}, I know I don't deserve your love after how cruel I've been. You doesn't know the real me, the me that aches to care for you and make you feel safe in my arms. I really wish I could find the courage to tell you how I feel..." 

By the time he finished, his hands were shaking and his chest heaving with sobs. On the playground outside the window, the crowd was laughing hysterically, but Steele didn't care anymore. For him, it was all over.

All of his most fragile and unspeakable secrets have been brutally exposed.  He seemed to be a man who had his clothes stripped off, standing helplessly under the spotlight, accepting the contemptuous looks of everyone, and among this group of viewers, there was you.

Finally, he couldn't bear it anymore, threw down the diary and rushed out of the broadcast room.  You heard the sound of his sneakers running down the corridor outside the door, which seemed to be accompanied by his whimpering...
